Title: Itinerario para parochos de indios, en que se tratan las materias mas particulares, tocantes a ellos, para su buena administracion
Creator: Alonso de la Peña Montenegro, bishop of San Francisco de Quito
Publisher: Madrid: por Joseph Fernandez de Buendia, 1668
Publication Date: 1668
Rights: Public Domain (published 1668, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item carries no rights field, so the date rule alone applies)
Language: spa
Source: Internet Archive item itinerarioparapa00peam (https://archive.org/details/itinerarioparapa00peam), the item's own itinerarioparapa00peam_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: University Library, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill; host metadata date: 1668. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-23. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: 4750a2e2e84ddb286af35b793963f9c306c43dbd7281dbb5e9e74cced8538ec9.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill scan; usable OCR with the long s read as f, Latin citations interleaved and some broken lines in the margins.
Content note: The bishop of Quito's handbook for priests of Indian parishes: the parish priest's duties, the Indians' sacraments, idolatry and superstition, marriage, and the cases of conscience peculiar to the Andean parish; a pastoral guide written from the bishop's own diocese.
